song.title: Pull Harder On The Strings Of Your Martyr

guitar.modelsText: Epiphone / Gibson Les Paul signature models
guitar.notes: Matt Heafy is well known for his Epiphone (later Gibson) Les Paul signature models; medium confidence as documentation is solid but the signature-model era postdates this earlier song.

tone.target: tight modern metalcore rhythm with aggressive mid bite
tone.profile: tight modern metalcore rhythm with aggressive mid bite
tone.summary: A tight, high-gain signal chain utilizing a Boost and Distortion for aggressive articulation, feeding into the Recti amp model with a 4x12 cab to achieve modern metalcore chug.
corrections: replace fuzz with tight hi-gain distortion
keep mids present enough for riff clarity

rig.name: Trivium - Pull Harder On The Strings Of Your Martyr - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and noise inherent in high-gain metal tones.
Provide the tight, aggressive boost and articulation needed for palm-muted chugging (Tube Screamer emulation).
blocks.gap: The dedicated Tube Screamer model is absent; Boost provides a suitable high-gain tightening function.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core high-gain metal tone and aggressive bite.
blocks.gap: The dedicated Mesa/Rectifier model is absent; general Distortion provides the necessary saturation level.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the powerful, scooped modern metal amplifier tone.
Provide a robust and articulate cabinet sound suitable for modern rhythm playing.
blocks.gap: While the ideal cab might be Mesa-specific, UK Vintage 4x12 offers sufficient punch and clarity.

blocks.purpose: Scoop the low end while boosting mids for riff clarity and bite.
Disabled for rhythm chugging to maintain maximum tightness and focus on the core tone.
Disabled to keep the rhythm dry and focused on articulation.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture Mesa/Rectifier cab character and improve overall mid-range bite.

proposals.reason: Better captures the desired Rectifier cabinet tone and punch.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in chugs.
